description: Tarot card meanings for The Lovers, The Chariot, Strength and The Hermit, upright and reversed, with practical notes for reading them in a spread.
lede: Four major arcana cards, from The Lovers (VI) to The Hermit (IX), with upright meanings, reversals and a tip for each.

faces.alt: Four original gold-linework tarot card faces in order: The Lovers (VI), The Chariot (VII), Strength (VIII) and The Hermit (IX). Each shows its Roman numeral on top and its name at the bottom with a four-point star, with no scenes.
faces.caption: The four cards covered here, in order. Card faces are original linework, not a published deck.
